changes: Saved-video players request playback mode on play/resume when the optional Audio Session API is available.
Short clip previews no longer force muted playback.
Voice tracking and transcription stop when opening results or ending a take.
Pending microphone requests are cancelled logically and late streams disposed; duplicate starts are suppressed.
Obsolete speech recognizers cannot restart from old callbacks.

validation.lint: no errors; pre-existing Fast Refresh warning in audit/prompter-flow-harness.tsx

limits: This is not confirmation of the original iPhone audio-routing cause.
Optional playback mode does not forcibly select speaker over headphones or Bluetooth.
Physical iPhone speaker/receiver routing still requires device validation.
Changes are local and have not been deployed or uploaded to stores.
